'''Flame jewels''' were a type of mineral that were found on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]. Along with [[Spice/Legends|Roon spice]] and [[Roonstone]]s, flame jewels were the reason for the planet's fame and were one of its major exports.<ref name="GatORW" />
